channel.description: Curated pieces for elevated living. Shipped Australia-wide.

item.g:title: Aurelia Marble & Gold Bathroom Set (5-Piece)
item.g:description: Turn a daily routine into a five-star ritual. The Aurelia set brings hand-glazed marble ceramic and hand-painted gold veining to your basin, each piece finished with a gilded base that catches the light. A complete five-piece collection that makes even the smallest bathroom feel like a boutique hotel, choose classic white, deep emerald green or midnight black, all pooled with liquid-gold marbling.

item.g:title: Dark Marble Bathroom Set (4-Piece)
item.g:description: Cut from solid Emperador Dark marble, this is the set that makes a bathroom feel like a hotel suite. The stone is a deep espresso brown shot through with pale gold and cream veining, and because every block is quarried rather than moulded, no two pieces in your set will ever match exactly. Weighty in the hand, cool to the touch, and finished with a polished gold pump. Four pieces that sit beautifully together on a vanity, or apart across the tray by the bath, the dispenser at the basin.

item.g:title: Minimalist Pump Soap Dispenser
item.g:description: A plain, well-proportioned pump dispenser for hand soap or lotion, in a finish that doesn't shout. Two sizes, so it suits a small powder room or a busy family basin, and three colours that sit quietly against most tiles.

item.g:title: Black Marble-Look & Gold Bathroom Collection
item.g:description: Black marble-look pieces with slim gold detailing, bought individually so you take only what your basin needs. Toothbrush holders, cups, a dispenser, a cotton swab box, soap dish, tissue box and two tray sizes, all cut to the same restrained line.

item.g:title: White Marble & Gold Bathroom Collection
item.g:description: Natural white marble with gold trim, in square or round shapes depending on how soft you want the look. The veining runs differently through every piece, so a set assembled from these never looks mass-produced.

item.g:title: Two-Tone Bathroom Bin
item.g:description: A bin you don't have to hide. Clean-sided and weighted enough to stay put, in two-tone colourways with and without a lid, so it works beside a vanity or under a desk just as well.

item.g:title: Touchless Sensor Bathroom Bin
item.g:description: Opens as your hand approaches and closes itself afterwards, which matters more in a bathroom than anywhere else in the house. Fully waterproof, in round, oval and square shapes, at 10 or 15 litres.

item.g:title: Emerald Marble Bathroom Accessories
item.g:description: Deep green natural marble with pale veining running through it, which is a far braver choice than white and looks remarkable against brass tapware. Square or round pieces, bought one at a time.

item.g:title: Fluted Sandstone-Look Bathroom Accessories
item.g:description: Bevelled vertical grooves give these pieces their texture, catching the light down the sides so a plain basin suddenly has something to look at. In marble white and warmer sandstone tones.

item.g:title: Sandstone Bathroom Collection
item.g:description: Premium sandstone, where the texture is the whole point: matte, grainy and warm rather than polished and cold. Buy the complete set, or add pieces one at a time.

item.g:title: Black Marble Bathroom Accessories Collection
item.g:description: Black natural marble with your choice of gold or silver fittings, which is the detail that decides whether a bathroom reads warm or cool. Each piece is cut from stone, so the veining is never repeated.

item.g:title: Crystal Glass Bathroom Accessories
item.g:description: Crystal glass with faceted sides that throw light around a basin the way cut glass does on a dining table. Five styles to choose between, all finished to the same standard.

item.g:title: Countertop Hand Towel Rack
item.g:description: A 32cm standing rack for the bench or vanity, so a hand towel has somewhere to live that isn't the edge of the basin. Black, gold or silver.

item.g:title: Egyptian Cotton Towel Set (700GSM, 3-Piece)
item.g:description: 700GSM Egyptian cotton, which is the weight where a towel stops being thin and starts feeling like a hotel. Three pieces per set, in six colours, absorbent from the first wash and soft after many.

item.g:title: Black & White Veined Bathroom Collection
item.g:description: A black finish with white veining running across it, which reads as marble from across the room and costs considerably less. The tray pulls the set together on a vanity.

item.g:title: Travertine Bathroom Collection
item.g:description: Travertine has an open, pitted texture that reads as old-world rather than glossy, and it suits a bathroom that's meant to feel calm. The widest set of pieces we carry, including a storage container and two soap dish shapes.

item.g:title: Rose Gold Bathroom Accessories Set
item.g:description: Rose gold detailing across a four-piece set: toothbrush holder, dispenser, soap dish and cup. Take the set, or fill a gap with a single piece.

item.g:title: Expandable Bamboo Bath Caddy
item.g:description: Extends to fit across the bath, then holds a book, a glass and a candle where you can reach them. Bamboo, so it copes with the steam, in white or black.

item.g:title: Clear Cosmetic Storage Box
item.g:description: A clear box that keeps brushes, lipsticks and skincare upright and visible instead of rolling loose in a drawer. Two sizes, and tidy enough to leave out on the vanity.

item.g:title: Glass Bathroom Accessories Set (4-Piece)
item.g:description: Four pieces in high-quality glass, in black or white, with the weight and clarity that cheap acrylic never manages. A whole basin dressed in one purchase.

item.g:title: Ceramic Marble-Look Bathroom Set (5-Piece)
item.g:description: Five ceramic pieces finished to look like marble, with gold accents, in emerald green, snow white or black. All the drama of stone, at a fraction of the price and weight.

item.g:title: Marble & Copper Floor Towel Holder
item.g:description: A freestanding towel holder on a solid marble base with copper rods, heavy enough to stay exactly where you put it. The piece that makes a bathroom look finished rather than furnished.

item.g:title: Porcelain Bathroom Set (5-Piece)
item.g:description: Five porcelain pieces with clean lines and nothing superfluous, made to work together on a single vanity.

item.g:title: Ceramic Bathroom Accessories Collection
item.g:description: Good ceramic in silver, white or gold trims, sold piece by piece: dispenser, cup and holder. The easy way to replace one tired item without rebuying the lot.

item.g:title: Marble-Base Rotating Vanity Mirror
item.g:description: A vanity mirror on a marble base that turns to the angle you need and stays there. Heavy enough not to creep across the bench while you use it.

item.g:title: Marble Toiletry Collection
item.g:description: Marble pieces at a larger scale than most: two tissue box designs, a generous tray, dispensers in gold or silver. For a bathroom with the bench space to carry them.

item.g:title: Expandable Timber Bath Caddy
item.g:description: Solid timber that extends across the bath, with room for a book, a glass and whatever else turns a bath into an hour to yourself.

item.g:title: Luxe Bathroom Set (4-Piece)
item.g:description: A four-piece set in two arrangements, made to dress a whole basin at once rather than be collected slowly.

item.g:title: Gilded Bathroom Accessories Set (4-Piece)
item.g:description: Four pieces with gilded detailing, available as a set or individually, so a single soap dish can be replaced without starting again.

item.g:title: Three-Tier Standing Towel Rack
item.g:description: Three hanging levels on a freestanding frame, which is what a family bathroom actually needs: somewhere for three towels to dry properly rather than overlap on one rail.

item.g:title: Stainless Steel & Marble Towel Holder
item.g:description: Stainless steel rods on a marble foot: the steel handles the damp, the marble handles the standing still. Black or brushed gold.

item.g:title: Beige Bathroom Set (5-Piece)
item.g:description: Five pieces in a soft beige that works with timber vanities and warm tiles, where a stark white set would look cold.

item.g:title: Tree Branch Wall Hook (78cm)

item.g:title: Dual-Rod Rotating Towel Rack

item.g:title: Standing Stainless Steel Towel Rack
item.g:description: A simple standing rack in stainless steel, which is the material that survives a wet bathroom without rusting at the joints. Black, brushed gold or brushed silver.

item.g:title: Two-Bar Floor Towel Rack with Storage

item.g:title: Marble-Base Vertical Towel Rack
item.g:description: A tall vertical rack on a marble base, which keeps the footprint small while holding full-size bath towels. Black.

item.g:title: Modern Bath Accessories Collection
item.g:description: Clean lines and a contemporary finish across a cotton swab box, dispenser, soap dish and tray. Unfussy pieces for a bathroom that doesn't want a theme.

item.g:title: Matte Bathroom Accessories Set (5-Piece)
item.g:description: A five-piece set in a soft matte finish, in grey or sandstone, that hides water spots far better than anything glossy.

item.g:title: Veined Marble Bathroom Accessories

item.g:title: Faceted Ceramic Bathroom Set (5-Piece)

item.g:title: Natural Marble Bathroom Accessories

item.g:title: Ceramic Bathroom Set (4-Piece)

item.g:title: Crystal Glass Bathroom Set (4-Piece)

item.g:title: Steel Fire Pit with Built-In Log Store
item.g:description: The reason everyone ends up outside. A broad steel fire bowl sits at the centre of a sculptural low table, with the firewood stacked in the open curve beneath it, so the fuel is part of the design rather than something to hide. The surround gives you somewhere to rest drinks, a board or a hand while the fire does the work. Stainless steel under a textured, heat-resistant black powder coat, built to live outside through an Australian winter. Five diameters, from 80cm for a courtyard to 150cm for a lawn that gathers a crowd, with matching seats sold separately.

item.g:title: Caged Solar Garden Lantern
item.g:description: A slender cage of stainless steel ribs around a column of warm light, charged by the sun and switched on by the dusk. No cable to run, no socket to find, so it can stand where you actually want light: along a path, beside the steps, at the end of a daybed, in a planter among the greenery.
